items.q: How much does bed bug furniture removal cost?
a: Bed bug furniture removal starts at $125. The final price depends on the furniture being removed, the pickup location and the work required. Call Live Junk Free at 647-922-5865 to discuss your pickup and get a price.

items.q: Can you remove bed bug furniture from an apartment or condo?
a: Yes. We do it regularly across the GTA. We work quickly and discreetly, bagging all items before they leave your unit to protect your neighbours and building.

items.q: How fast can you remove the furniture?
a: We offer same-day furniture removal, subject to crew availability and pickup location. Call us at 647-922-5865 to check the earliest available pickup.

items.q: Do you remove bed bug mattresses?
a: Yes. We remove bed bug-affected mattresses and other furniture, including sofas, chairs and bed frames. Let us know which items need to be removed when you call so our crew can prepare for the pickup.

Our crew takes precautions when removing bed bug-affected furniture. Team members wear shoe covers, wrap furniture and bag smaller items for removal. The team also takes care when handling and disposing of affected furniture.
We cover the full GTA including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Scarborough, North York, Etobicoke, Newmarket, Oshawa, Ajax and more. Call 647-922-5865 to confirm.
